propositions: Every typed configuration key emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a nonempty public_description metadata field co-located with the dataclass field definition.
The configuration reference generator must require and enforce nonempty descriptions for all emitted fields, failing generation when a description is missing or empty and naming the offending key.
Each generated Description cell in the configuration reference must state a user-visible effect or operational consequence rather than merely restating the key's type, default value, or lifecycle.
The configuration schema module must remain below the 800-line absolute size limit after adding public_description metadata across all fields.

All 100 generated configuration rows must be manually reviewed row-by-row to confirm descriptions do not restate type, default, or lifecycle, with reviewer identity and UTC timestamp recorded in a ticket comment.
